summary.text: An Enuani speaking (Anioma) LGA with its headquarters at Akwukwu-Igbo. Ebu, on the Niger, is an Igala speaking kingdom of eight villages whose people came from Idah.

peoples.name: Anioma (Enuani)
peoples.note: Whether the Anioma are Igbo is debated; see the Anioma profile.

history.text: Ebu, one of its towns, was founded by Igala speaking people who migrated from Idah across the Niger.
